channel.title: FridgePaper: Chore Charts for Kids
channel.description: Free printables from FridgePaper for the Chore Charts for Kids board.

item.title: Winter Break Chore Chart for Kids (Free Printable Game Board)
item.description: Keep kids helping all winter break! Kids color a square on a snowy game board for every chore and race to a winter prize. Picture chores, rainbow day circles, and a blank row for your own. Free printable, ready for the fridge.

item.title: Free Printable Chore Chart for Kids
item.description: Turn chores into a board game! Kids color a square every time they finish a chore and race to the treasure chest prize. Free printable weekly chore chart with picture icons, great for ages 4 to 12.

item.title: Custom Chore Chart Maker (Free, Print in 1 Minute)
item.description: Type in your child's name and chores and get a custom printable chore chart in under a minute. Free, no sign-up, works on your phone. Make a different chart for every kid.

item.title: How Much Allowance by Age? Free Allowance Calculator
item.description: Figure out a fair allowance for each of your kids in seconds. Pick a dollar amount per year of age and split it into save, spend and give. Free calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Free Printable Toddler Chore Chart (Ages 2 to 4)
item.description: Toddlers love to help! This free printable chore chart for ages 2 to 4 has five easy jobs with pictures, big circles to color in, and a reward line. Print it and hang it at their eye level.

item.title: Free Printable Chore Chart for Teens (with Pay Tracker)
item.description: A chore chart teenagers will actually use. Real household jobs, simple check boxes, and a line to track the money they earn each week. Free to print.

item.title: Summer Chore Chart for Kids: Before Screens Checklist
item.description: End the summer screen-time battle. Kids finish their chores, reading and outside time first, then screens. Free printable summer chore chart and daily checklist.

item.title: Age-Appropriate Chores for Kids: A List by Age (2 to 16)
item.description: What chores can a 4-year-old do? A 10-year-old? A teen? A simple list of age-appropriate chores from toddlers to teens, plus tips for teaching them and free printable chore charts.

item.title: How to Make a Chore Chart That Actually Works (8 Tips)
item.description: Why do chore charts stop working after two weeks? 8 simple tips to make one your kids will keep using, plus free printable chore charts to get started today.
